name: billing-auth
description: The tiny TypeScript fixture used by the Context Agent tests (two modules, 6 files). Too small to separate the modes; it keeps the harness honest on a repo anyone can read in a minute.

cases.task: Charge a customer's card and refund part of an invoice payment
Issue and verify session tokens when a user logs in
Calculate the invoice total from a list of line items
Hash user passwords and check them when someone signs in
Only let signed-in users reach billing
